description: This file defines the TypedContentTypeBuilder class which implements IContentTypeBuilder. It constructs GraphQL content types by adding fields and resolving content parts based on content type definitions, options, and schema types within OrchardCore's GraphQL content management system.

classes.name: TypedContentTypeBuilder
classes.description: A class responsible for building GraphQL content types by adding fields for content parts, handling collapsing, and setting up resolvers based on content type definitions and options.

methods.name: Build
methods.description: Constructs GraphQL fields for a given content type definition, adding both object and input types, with support for collapsing parts and setting up resolvers.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: A placeholder method with no implementation, possibly for resetting or clearing internal state.
